I've fixed the Marrow Agrisupply record in GBrain. I withdrew the Dock 23 entry and saved a new one: the new inbound lane is at Gate 47. The new entry cites Pree's correction message and notes that it replaces the Dock 23 one. I replied in Pree's thread to say it's corrected.

GBrain's search is keyword-only, so it couldn't check for other notes that say Dock 23 in different words. The only saved fact on the account is now the Gate 47 one.

One small slip: the reason I gave when withdrawing the old entry calls Pree "she." Pree's pronouns weren't stated, so that should have been "they." GBrain keeps that reason in its audit trail and I can't edit it.
